title: squarespace.create_order
description: Input/output contract for creating an order. POST /orders on the commerce base URL (https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce). SAFETY: per connector.yaml this action is irreversible and requires approval before execution; Squarespace rejects the request outright without an Idempotency-Key header, and rate-limits it to 100 calls per hour per site. VERIFICATION STATUS: the REQUEST shape below now matches Squarespace's official documented CreateOrderRequest/CreateLineItemRequest contract, reconciled 2026-08-10 directly against that authoritative source — superseding the shape previously inferred from 4 live 400 rejections and from the read-side/response shape. Field-level confidence varies: lineItemType "PHYSICAL_PRODUCT" is confirmed correct for physical products; for that lineItemType, title is CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11, to be forbidden (must be null or omitted — "lineItems.title must be null or omitted" when lineItemType is PHYSICAL_PRODUCT), correcting the earlier assumption that title was unconditionally required — title's requirement for any OTHER lineItemType value remains UNCONFIRMED, no data yet; shopperFulfillmentNotificationBehavior is a confirmed enum, exactly "SEND" or "SKIP"; nonSaleUnitPrice's optionality is inferred from its descriptive purpose, not explicitly confirmed; fulfillments' item shape remains unconfirmed (an empty array is the safe default). END-TO-END SUCCESS IS STILL UNVERIFIED — no order has ever been successfully created against the live API. The output side is unchanged by this reconciliation and still mirrors the placeholder in fixtures/create-order-response.json.

input.title: CreateOrderInput
input.description: Matches Squarespace's official CreateOrderRequest contract (reconciled 2026-08-10). Monetary totals are supplied by the caller rather than computed by the API, so they must be internally consistent with lineItems.

idempotencyKey.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key request header, not in the body. Optional on this input — the connector generates a fresh UUID when omitted, and reuses the caller's when supplied. Reuse the same key when retrying so a retry cannot create a duplicate order.

channelName.description: Sales channel label recorded on the order, e.g. "doo-connector". REQUIRED, max length 30 — confirmed against Squarespace's official CreateOrderRequest contract, 2026-08-10.

createdOn.description: REQUIRED — confirmed against Squarespace's official CreateOrderRequest contract, 2026-08-10. The caller supplies this order-creation timestamp (ISO 8601); it is not computed by the API.

externalOrderReference.description: Caller-side identifier for reconciliation. REQUIRED, max length 200 — confirmed against Squarespace's official CreateOrderRequest contract, 2026-08-10.

fulfillments.description: REQUIRED — confirmed against Squarespace's official CreateOrderRequest contract, 2026-08-10. Must be present (not omitted); an empty array is valid and expected for a newly created order with no fulfillments yet. Item shape is UNVERIFIED — not needed for typical order creation, so [] is the safe default.

priceTaxInterpretation.description: REQUIRED, exactly "EXCLUSIVE" or "INCLUSIVE" — confirmed against Squarespace's official CreateOrderRequest contract, 2026-08-10. No default: the caller must choose. (Previously modelled with a default of "EXCLUSIVE" implying optionality — that was wrong.)

customerEmail.description: NOT required — confirmed against Squarespace's official CreateOrderRequest contract, 2026-08-10. (Previously modelled as required — that was wrong.)

fulfilledOn.description: NOT required. ISO 8601. Distinct from fulfillments (the array) and fulfillmentStatus (the enum) — confirmed against Squarespace's official CreateOrderRequest contract, 2026-08-10.

inventoryBehavior.description: NOT required. UNVERIFIED which value creating the order actually applies by default; whether creating the order draws down stock at all remains unconfirmed.

shopperFulfillmentNotificationBehavior.description: NOT required. CONFIRMED enum, 2026-08-10: exactly "SEND" or "SKIP" — controls whether Squarespace emails the customer a fulfillment notification.

examples.description: Request shape matches Squarespace's official contract (reconciled 2026-08-10). nonSaleUnitPrice is omitted since its optionality is only inferred, not confirmed. fulfillments is present as [], per the confirmed requirement. The PHYSICAL_PRODUCT line item omits title — confirmed live, 2026-08-11, that a non-null title is rejected in that case. This example has not itself been submitted live — end-to-end success remains unverified.

money.title: Money
money.description: Squarespace's official type name for this shape is MonetaryAmount; kept as "money" here for consistency with the rest of this connector's schemas.

lineItemInput.title: CreateLineItemRequest
lineItemInput.description: Matches Squarespace's official CreateLineItemRequest contract exactly, reconciled 2026-08-10 against that authoritative source (not inferred from the response shape). sku does not exist on this request shape at all — it's response-only (see $defs.lineItem) — so unlike the top-level input above, there's nothing to structurally forbid here; it's simply not a defined property. title is NOT unconditionally required — see its own note and the `if`/`then` below: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11, forbidden (must be null/omitted) when lineItemType is PHYSICAL_PRODUCT; UNCONFIRMED for any other lineItemType value.

then.description: Structural enforcement of the title note below: when lineItemType is PHYSICAL_PRODUCT, title must be null if present at all.

lineItemType.description: CONFIRMED, 2026-08-10: "PHYSICAL_PRODUCT" is correct for physical products — this connector's only tested case so far. Other product types (digital goods, services, gift cards, etc.) likely use different values; unconfirmed, and not needed until the connector handles those types.

title.description: Squarespace's official field name for the line item's display name on this request. NOT productName — that's a response-only field name (see $defs.lineItem). REQUIREMENT DEPENDS ON lineItemType: for "PHYSICAL_PRODUCT", CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11 — must be null or omitted; Squarespace responds 400 INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR, "lineItems.title must be null or omitted.", if a non-null title is sent alongside PHYSICAL_PRODUCT (presumably because it's derived from the catalog product via variantId). For any OTHER lineItemType value, title's requirement (required / optional / forbidden) is UNCONFIRMED — no data yet, do not guess.

nonSaleUnitPrice.description: INFERRED, not confirmed — appears optional based on its descriptive purpose (presumably the item's regular price when unitPricePaid reflects a sale/discounted price). Not explicitly confirmed as optional vs required.

lineItem.title: OrderLineItem
lineItem.description: Response shape — distinct from $defs.lineItemInput (the request shape). Unaffected by the 2026-08-10 request-side reconciliation.

order.title: Order
order.description: UNVERIFIED — mirrors fixtures/create-order-response.json, itself a placeholder. Unaffected by the 2026-08-10 request-side reconciliation.
